label: NMIEntry
description: Hardware NMI trampoline through writable RAM vector $0076/$0077.

label: NMIDefault
description: Preserve A, write zero to $1E00, and RTI. Hardware side effect remains unresolved.

label: ResetEntry
description: SEI/CLD, fixed page-1 stack, marker test, cold/warm initialization, then cartridge search.

label: CheckWarmStartMarker
description: Compare all 17 copyright bytes against RAM $0100-$0110.

label: ColdStartInitialize
description: Clear zero page; fill user phrase storage with $FF. Do not clear the full command area.

label: InitializeCommonState
description: Runs on warm and cold reset; reinstall marker, vectors, remote ages, and music state.

label: ScanCartridge
description: Probe $2000,$3000,...,$B000 for four signature bytes; no $C000 probe.

label: CompareCartridgeSignature
description: Y=5..2: compare candidate bytes with CopyrightText-2,Y ($E003..$E000).

label: DispatchCartridge
description: Jump through the header-supplied pointer; this is not a JSR and has no RTS return.

label: ContinueStockStartup
description: Stock continuation: head command, motor auxiliary status, CLI, spoken greeting.

label: MainModeEntry
description: Normal foreground entry. Initializes immediate-mode state and resets the stack later.

label: EnterForegroundMode
description: Store mode and dispatch to its user interface; this path is not a callable API.

label: ImmediateLearnCommandLoop
description: Read and classify keys in immediate/LEARN operation.

label: ReadStatusOption
description: Settings keys 0..6; index=19+2*key selects paired display presets.

label: RecordLearnMotion
description: LEARN-mode motion bookkeeping before storing a command.

label: UpdateLearnOperand
description: Search earlier learned operation and replace its operand when appropriate.

label: InsertCurrentCommandIfLearning
description: Guarded insertion entry: mode must be LEARN before falling into insertion.

label: InsertProgramCommand
description: Find the end marker, enforce biased cursor $037E boundary, shift pairs, and insert.

label: PrepareProgramInsertion
description: Copy biased cursor to temporary pointer and scan/shift command pairs.

label: EditProgramLoop
description: Program-mode editing loop; reads keys and supports clear/backstep/execute.

label: ClearProgramStep
description: Clear/delete editing path. Uses program and temporary cursors.

label: WaitForKeyOrTimer
description: Set $2A=$F4; return when remote mailbox is nonempty or the IRQ timer reaches zero.

label: ProgramBackstep
description: Move to an earlier command, subject to the beginning boundary.

label: ExecuteSelectedStep
description: Fetch/display selected command and wait for the relevant key.

label: AdvanceProgramCursor
description: Increment biased 16-bit program cursor by two, carrying into its high byte.

label: ClearEntireProgram
description: Reset cursor, place $FF end marker, show clear-program preset.

label: ExecuteProgram
description: Execute stored command pairs, handling reverse direction, delays, music and speech.

label: WaitForRobotActivities
description: Service robot until motor, speech, and music activity clears; stall/service paths can redirect control.

label: FetchProgramCommand
description: Read operand at cursor+$81, opcode at cursor+$80 into $13/$11; A returns opcode.

label: TransformReverseCommand
description: Reverse-execution transformation for motion and open/close operands.

label: RetreatProgramCursor
description: Carry clear at beginning ($0180); otherwise subtract two and return carry set. Listing labels repaired from binary.

label: ResetCursorUnlessEditing
description: Feature bit 6 controls whether the existing cursor/program is retained.

label: MarkProgramEnd
description: Write $FF at biased cursor+$80.

label: ResetProgramCursor
description: Initialize biased cursor to USER_PROGRAM-$80; reset execution direction state.

label: ReadOperandViaVector
description: Indirect command-input hook, initially ReadOperandDefault.

label: ReadOperandDefault
description: Numeric operand entry and per-command bounds; carry indicates acceptance.

label: WaitForSpecificRemoteEvent
description: A selects event to wait for; consumes mailbox events and waits again on mismatch.

label: WaitForRemoteKey
description: Wait for a foreground key below $20, servicing robot and mode handling.

label: ReadRemoteAndHandleModes
description: Remote UI dispatch; may enter another mode instead of returning.

label: PollRobotAndRemote
description: Run motor/service polling, wheel-speed adjustment, then consume remote mailbox.

label: HandleImmediateMotion
description: Immediate/LEARN operation handling, motor status and direction commands.

label: StopAllMotors
description: Stop command depends on coupling; delay, reconcile four positions, then handshake.

label: StopWheels
description: Send wheel-stop byte, delay, reconcile position, clear wheel status/speed.

label: RampWheelSpeed
description: Immediate/LEARN speed change after timer expiry; resends direction and speed parameter.

label: StartForwardWheels
description: Set wheel direction/status and fall through to speed-command transmission.

label: SendMotorSpeed
description: Send A, then speed-state+3. Uses common motor serializer.

label: StartReverseWheels
description: Set reverse wheel state and send the reverse speed command.

label: WaitForMotorCompletion
description: Poll B0 until zero and B1 until claw activity bits clear; runs service paths.

label: MotorSettlingDelay
description: Set $2A=$18 and wait for interrupt timer service to decrement it to zero.

label: MotorHandshakeService
description: Motor handshake/status path using $1000 bit 7 and command $C1.

label: ExecuteMotorCommand
description: A=operation, $13=operand. Busy/limit checks and hardware handshake precede dispatch.

label: MotorOperationDispatch
description: Clear rejected bit, ignore negative operation, and skip zero-count moves 0..8.

label: CheckMotorLeft
description: Operation 0: left turn; selected direction depends on saved wheel direction.

label: CheckMotorForward
description: Operation 1: forward movement; skip/reject if wheel group is busy.

label: CheckMotorReverse
description: Operation 2: reverse movement.

label: SendMotorCommandAndOperand
description: A=command; send it, then tail-call sender with $13 operand.

label: CheckMotorRight
description: Operation 3: right turn; command depends on saved direction.

label: CheckMotorWristUp
description: Operation 4: wrist-up; activity mask $30 and inhibit bit 6.

label: CheckMotorWristDown
description: Operation 5: wrist-down; activity mask $30 and inhibit bit 7.

label: CheckMotorArmsUp
description: Operation 6: arms-up; coupling flag can add wrist-down activity.

label: CheckMotorArmsDown
description: Operation 7: arms-down; coupling flag can add wrist-up activity.

label: CheckMotorClawRotate
description: Operation 8: claw rotation with supplied count.

label: CheckMotorClawOpenClose
description: Operation 9: one-byte open/close command selected by operand.

label: CheckMotorHeadlamp
description: Operation 10: operand selects headlamp on/off state.

label: SetHeadlampOff
description: Clear headlamp state $71; actual output is applied by IRQ headlamp service.

label: SetHeadlampOn
description: Set headlamp state $71=$40.

label: HomeRobot
description: Homing sequence: 60,62; wait; 70,61; wait; initialize counters; C0/C1 handshake.

label: WaitMotorHandshakeHigh
description: Return when $1000 bit 7 is high; otherwise send $C1 and retry.

label: UpdateSelectedPosition
description: Dispatch by X to a counter read and direction-dependent position update.

label: ReadApplyWheelCounter
description: A is supplied request (84 ordinary / 44 completion); apply count to wheel position.

label: ReadApplyWristCounter
description: A is supplied request (82 / 42); update wrist position and saved count.

label: ReadApplyArmCounter
description: A is supplied request (81 / 41); update arm position and saved count.

label: ReadApplyClawCounter
description: A is supplied request (80 / 40); reduce count and position modulo $55 (85).

label: RejectMotorOperation
description: Set operation-status bit 7 and return.

label: FinalizeWheelPosition
description: Undo prior contribution, read completion counter 44, then clear saved counters.

label: FinalizeWristPosition
description: Completion-counter path for wrist, request 42.

label: FinalizeArmPosition
description: Completion-counter path for arm, request 41.

label: FinalizeClawPosition
description: Completion-counter path for claw, request 40.

label: UndoWheelCount
description: Undo the previous counter contribution using saved wheel direction.

label: UndoWristCount
description: Undo prior wrist count using direction bit 4.

label: UndoArmCount
description: Undo prior arm count using direction bit 6.

label: UndoClawCount
description: Subtract prior claw count before replacing it.

label: BeginHeadDisplayFrame
description: Send E3, then F3. Fall through into head-byte transmitter.

label: SendHeadByte
description: A=byte; MSB first. Uses $5E/$5F/$60; head data phases are $1A/$1B.

label: SendMotorByte
description: A=byte; shares serializer, motor data phases $1C/$1D.

label: SerialTransmitSetup
description: Shared serializer. Poll timing bit 6, shift outgoing bit, restore idle $F8.

label: WaitSerialClockHigh
description: Wait until BIT $1000 sets V (bit 6 high).

label: WaitSerialClockLow
description: Wait until BIT $1000 clears V (bit 6 low).

label: ReadMotorReply
description: Send A request; receive eight MSB-first bits from $1000 bit 0, then complement result.

label: WaitReplyClockHigh
description: Receive-phase timing wait for bit 6 high.

label: WaitReplyClockLow
description: Receive-phase timing wait for bit 6 low.

label: PollMotorProgressAndService
description: When timer allows: B1/B0 then active counters. Equal consecutive count enters stall path.

label: HandleMotorStall
description: Stop motors, show StAL, increment diagnostic counter, sound error, return through mode vector.

label: ServiceViaVector
description: Indirect service hook, initially ServiceDefault.

label: ServiceDefault
description: Alarm response, inactivity power-down, and battery warning foreground service.

label: EnterSleep
description: SEI; write $02 to system control, send head sleep command, then loop. Wake mechanism is hardware-dependent.

label: TimerIRQ
description: IRQ task: periodic/inactivity/motor timers and battery status. Returns through IRQRestore.

label: HeadlampIRQ
description: IRQ task: headlamp shadow/divider and output at $1000. Returns through IRQRestore.

label: ClearMusicEffectsAndInitialize
description: Clear effect mask then continue to voice initialization.

label: InitializeMusicVoices
description: Reset voice state and mute channels; called by reset before cartridge dispatch.

label: SelectTune
description: X=tune index 0..8; load six split stream-pointer bytes and activate voice state.

label: PlayFeedbackTone3C
description: Choose feedback pitch/control $3C, then common short-tone path.

label: PlayFeedbackTone3A
description: Choose feedback pitch/control $3A.

label: PlayFeedbackTone36
description: Choose feedback pitch/control $36.

label: PlayFeedbackToneCommon
description: A=$0A duration; Y supplied pitch/control; share error-tone launch path.

label: PlayErrorTone
description: Start short foreground feedback/error tone unless music activity blocks it.

label: ClearUserTune
description: Clear $0400-$04FF and reset tune editor offset/octave state.

label: WaitForTune
description: Wait for voice-0 active/state byte to become zero; depends on IRQ music service.

label: EditUserTune
description: User-song editor/key loop.

label: LearnUserTune
description: Select song/learn-song path and show Song prompt.

label: ProgramUserTune
description: Program-song path, note entry and clear/replay operations.

label: RefreshTuneDisplayIfChanged
description: Preserve A; compare note-base and duration selection, refresh tune display on change.

label: DisplayTuneEditor
description: Preserve A/X/Y; display note offset, pitch and duration, with octave point.

label: FindDurationIndex
description: Find duration encoding by comparing the biased table; table index zero overlaps the RTS byte.

label: SetTuneNote
description: Update programmable note data and editor state.

label: MusicIRQ
description: IRQ task for slots 0,1,2; stream duration/note fetch or effect RTS dispatch.

label: ProgramTone
description: First writes raw note to lamps; compute period and emit four encoded writes to $1C00.

label: StopMusicVoice0
description: Choose voice zero then disable effect/mute it.

label: StopMusicVoice1
description: Choose voice one then disable effect/mute it.

label: StopMusicVoice2
description: Choose voice two then disable effect/mute it.

label: DisableSelectedMusicEffect
description: Clear selected voice effect mask then fall through to mute.

label: MuteSelectedMusicVoice
description: Write channel-control|$0F to tone port.

label: SoundWriteDelay
description: Tiny call/NOP timing delay between sound-port writes. Preserve exact instruction layout.

label: SoundWriteDelayInner
description: Two NOPs then RTS; cycle timing is part of stock sound programming.

label: WaitForKeyPressAndRelease
description: Consume a press then corresponding release while running service dispatch.

label: ConfigureOscillatingEffect
description: Music-effect entry; sets voice and handler/timing parameters.

label: ConfigureSweepEffect
description: Music-effect setup used by games and other tone paths.

label: ConfigureRandomEffect
description: Configure the random-effect handler with supplied parameter.

label: ConfigureDecayEffect
description: Configure effect decay/timing.

label: ConfigureMusicEffectCommon
description: Install split RTS handler pointer and set effect-active mask.

label: MusicDecayEffectIRQ
description: Music-effect callback entered through RTS table; returns through IRQ restore paths.

label: MusicSweepEffectIRQ
description: Effect callback and shared effect-step update.

label: AdvanceMusicEffectStep
description: Update effect counters and value/increment; call context can alter return stack.

label: MusicRandomEffectIRQ
description: Calls NextRandom. This dependency prevents deleting all game-adjacent code wholesale.

label: MusicOscillatingEffectIRQ
description: Reverse increment at effect endpoints.

label: MusicRepeatedSweepIRQ
description: Effect repetition/counter path.

label: EditSpeechPhrase
description: Select user phrase slot and write vocabulary codes/terminator into $0500 page.

label: SpeakVocabularyViaVector
description: Writable low-level vocabulary hook, initially SpeakVocabularyDefault.

label: SpeakVocabularyDefault
description: X=vocabulary code; 140 is pause. Send external speech address via $1400, not CPU memory mapping.

label: SpeakPhrase
description: X=phrase index; 0..15 use RAM slots, 16..32 scan ROM $FF-terminated token sequences.

label: ExecuteSpeechCommand
description: Dispatch stored sound/sentence operation using current opcode and operand.

label: SpeakDirectSound
description: Prepare direct-sound state and invoke vocabulary dispatch.

label: SendSpeechByte
description: Send high nibble first, then leave low nibble in Y for caller.

label: SendSpeechNibble
description: A=nibble; write data, strobe bit 4 high, then low.

label: SpeakPromptUnlessDisabled
description: Feature bit 1 suppresses verbal prompts; programmed speech is a separate path.

label: WaitForSpeech
description: Wait for speech state to clear; playback depends on IRQ service.

label: SpeechIRQ
description: IRQ slot 7: busy/ready handling, phrase advancement, software pause, lamp updates.

label: DisplayProgramPosition
description: Derive step number from biased cursor, convert to BCD, and send numeric display.

label: DisplayOperandPrompt
description: Prompt-format entry with leading/placeholder behavior.

label: DisplayCommandOperand
description: Format $11/$13; special FE/FF selects beginning/end presets, 0B selects init.

label: DisplayPreset
description: X=0..31; send four glyphs from split preset tables and commit.

label: DisplayMixedCommand
description: Command-specific label glyphs combined with decimal operand digits.

label: DisplayNumberBlanked
description: Numeric formatting with leading blanks.

label: DisplayNumberZeroFilled
description: Display packed BCD $24/$25 with leading zeroes.

label: DisplayNumberCommon
description: Shared four-digit formatter; X controls leading-zero suppression.

label: OperandToBCD
description: Load current operand then convert to packed BCD.

label: ByteToBCD
description: A=unsigned byte; result in $24/$25. Temporarily enters decimal mode and clears it before RTS.

label: ClockInvalidKey
description: Sound feedback for invalid clock-menu input then retry.

label: ClockMenu
description: Keys adjust/view time/alarm and toggle auto-execution. Head COP maintains clock state.

label: AdjustClockRepeatedly
description: A=view select, X=adjust command; $16 controls repeat acceleration, $2A supplies delay.

label: GamesEntry
description: Game-mode entry; homes robot, prompts selection, then dispatches first/second game.

label: ClearGameState
description: Clear $A6-$AD with X=7..0. $AD is used despite no direct operand.

label: ChooseGameDifficulty
description: Prompt for difficulty then use numeric selection helper.

label: PromptForSmallNumber
description: Prompt/operand loop; game/difficulty interpretation depends on caller.

label: DisplayGameValue
description: Copy game value $A7/$A8 to shared display scratch.

label: NextRandom
description: Shared 16-bit shift state $A4/$A5. SEI then unconditional CLI: does not preserve caller interrupt mask.

label: GameWaitForMotion
description: Poll/complete game motion and select subsequent game action.

label: RemoteService
description: Runs every IRQ. Software serial decoder on $1400 bit 7, held-key aging and event delivery.

label: EnqueueRemoteEvent
description: Convert one-based event to queue code, store ring entry, decrement/wrap producer.

label: PublishRemoteEvent
description: Publish queued event if foreground mailbox is empty.

label: IRQEntry
description: Hardware IRQ trampoline through writable RAM vector $0078/$0079.

label: IRQDefault
description: Save A/X/Y, run receiver, select one of eight tasks, dispatch by pushing target-minus-one and RTS.

label: IRQRestore
description: Restore Y/X/A from default IRQ stack frame and RTI.
